integrity: The topology and cyclic triangulation are cited prior work; only the exact count, complete primitive class profile, symmetry orbit, and integral generation by shortest induced four-cycles are evaluated here. All finite checks have reproducible standard-library code and saved output.
scientific_limitations: Only the unit-edge-length simple integral homology 1-systoles of the thirteen-vertex Paley clique triangulation are classified; no claim is made for non-Paley tori, higher-length cycles, geometric flat metrics, or independent external certification. Similar results in differently indexed literature remain possible.
title: Thirty-nine primitive quadrilateral systoles on the Paley thirteen-vertex torus
